caption: The drawing features a bonnet that is primarily composed of a woven straw-like material in beige and light brown tones, with a crisscross pattern incorporating faint blue and pink lines. The interior lining of the bonnet is colored in a solid pink shade. A wide pink ribbon embellishes the bonnet along the opening, forming a large decorative ruffle in the center and around the bottom edge, with the ribbon extending downward and tied into a bow with long, flowing ends. There are two additional pencil sketches on the right side of the drawing, both outlining the same bonnet; one sketch is a side profile showing the ruffled and ribboned details, while the other is a top-down view showing the oval shape and decorative arrangement, both in monochromatic pencil. The background of the drawing transitions from an off-white at the bottom to a subtle gradient of beige at the top. The artist's signature is located at the lower left corner.
title: Child's Bonnet
